resources.string:
Lilyly stores the cycle, mood, medication, sleep, therapy and journal records you enter on your device. It uses those records to show your entries, reminders and the patterns you choose. No Lilyly account is required. This build has no Internet permission, advertising or analytics service.

Record text is encrypted using Android Keystore. Books and copied images are kept in private app storage; selected documents can also remain with their original provider. App lock uses Android authentication. Lilyly does not receive your fingerprint.

When you choose an external link, Android opens another app. Backups, exported PDFs and documents you choose may be stored by another provider. Backups require a password; exported PDFs can be read by anyone with the file.

Records stay until removed. To erase this installation’s local records and copied files, open Android app settings, choose Storage, then Clear data. External originals, exports, backups and separate Lilyly installations must be managed separately.

Lilyly is a personal journal and wellness tracker. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. Cycle dates are estimates, not contraception. Medication reminders reflect the schedule you enter. Ask a qualified health professional about treatment, medication or fertility decisions.
